ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a circular cake, from which a sector-shaped cake slice has been cut out; the question mark is marked between the two straight sides of this sector slice, representing the central angle of the sector. Beside it, it is labeled that this cut-out part is 15% of the whole cake. Then reason: The proportion of a sector's area in the whole circle's area equals the proportion of its central angle in 360°. method.method_draft: Identify from the figure that the removed piece is a sector-shaped slice of the circular cake and that the question mark labels the central angle of that slice, between its two straight radial cut edges. Use the text statement that this slice is 15% of the whole round cake. Since a sector's area fraction of a circle equals its central-angle fraction of 360 degrees, compute 0.15 × 360° = 54°.
